# P37.35 — Detector routing and mapping campaigns

## What landed

- **Predicate→task routing**: `tasks.detect` routes coverage gaps through `gap_routing.toml` (the P36.58-committed table) — `research` mints the asserted type + records `predicate_ids`; `campaign`/`metric` lanes never mint per-object tasks; untracked predicates keep the records-obtainable fallback.
- **Catalog rows 35/36**: `retention_unknown`, `sharing_unknown` (records_requester, testable closing conditions) — §33.2 enumerates 36 (spec_src amended + R11-X4, `make gen`-equivalent BUILD.sh run; ADR-245).
- **`research_task.predicate_ids` + `disposition_reason`** — additive sqitch `research_task_predicates` (nullable, no default) + column-scoped `UPDATE (status, disposition, disposition_reason)` grant to `sig_materialize` (disappearance_event_grant precedent — an EVENT surface, never a delete).
- **Jurisdiction**: contradiction/stale/coverage/contract candidates mint the subject's evidenced `jurisdiction:`-link attribution (`unplaced` otherwise).
- **Campaign aggregation**: run aggregates by `(jurisdiction, predicate, subject_class)`; export sources campaign members from the materialized coverage rows (card members deduped).
- **Supersede by disposition**: persisted `coverage_hole` rows citing campaign/metric refs and mis-routed rows get `closed`/`superseded` + reason — append-only; closed/superseded rows leave the public queue lanes.
